name: daikin
description: Daikin supplier portal: base app + ASN, Schedule Release and Purchase Order apps

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix base-app && npm install --prefix advance-shipment-notes && npm install --prefix schedule-release && npm install --prefix purchase-order
scripts.dev: concurrently -n base,asn,sr,po -c blue,cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix base-app" "npm run dev --prefix advance-shipment-notes" "npm run dev --prefix schedule-release" "npm run dev --prefix purchase-order"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix base-app && npm run build --prefix advance-shipment-notes && npm run build --prefix schedule-release && npm run build --prefix purchase-order
